headword: {社員旅行|しゃいんりょこう}

definitions.explanation: A trip that a company organizes and usually pays for, on which employees travel together, often with an overnight stay at a hot-spring inn and a banquet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{社員旅行|しゃいんりょこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧だ。
examples.english: This year's company trip is to Okinawa.

examples.japanese: {社員旅行|しゃいんりょこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧です。
examples.english: Taking part in the company trip is optional.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{社員旅行|しゃいんりょこう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧いえば⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{宴会|えんかい}→宴会：04104_enkai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{行|い}かない→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Company trips used to mean a banquet at a hot spring, but these days more companies don't hold them at all.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
The {社員旅行|しゃいんりょこう} was a fixture of Japanese company life in the postwar boom years, meant to build team spirit. Many companies dropped it as younger employees came to resent giving up weekends to colleagues, though some now offer shorter or overseas trips as a perk.
